_comment: Candidate models for the S6 Advanced Mathematics tutor.
Tiers exist because the tablet's RAM ceiling is not known until
00_device_profile.sh has run. Fetch tier A first; only fetch tier B if the
Sizes are approximate and are confirmed after download.
Filenames are resolved from the Hugging Face API, not hardcoded, because

generation.why: Mathematics-specialized at a size that fits a low-end tablet. Primary candidate for the pilot.
Same size and family as the math model but general purpose. Isolates how much the math specialization is worth.
Known to be weak at advanced mathematics. Acts as the low control, so the evaluation can show that retrieval grounding lifts a weak model.
Newer architecture with an explicit reasoning mode, which suits multi-step mathematics if latency allows it.
Tests whether doubling parameters buys enough accuracy to justify the memory cost.
Upper bound on quality. Likely too large for a 3 GB tablet, but establishes the ceiling we are trading away.

embedding.why: 384-dimension English retrieval embeddings, small enough to keep resident alongside the generation model.
Smaller fallback if the embedding model has to share memory with a tier B generation model.
